notes: **Respiratory / O₂:** mean 15.5 breaths/min, range 12–19; mean SpO₂ 97.5%, n = 200,020.
**Neural:** brain tissue has no standard bpm or breaths-per-minute vital-sign equivalent.

steps.title: Cardiovascular pressure reading
notes: **Systemic arterial:** mean systolic 124.4 mmHg (110–139); mean diastolic 79.5 mmHg (70–89); mean arterial pressure 94.5 mmHg. Heart / vascular-specific signature.

brain.label: Brain
brain.about: Neurons are organised in layers (the neocortex has six). Their electrical activity is variable and is recorded as an EEG. Mature neurons have very limited ability to regenerate.

heart.label: Heart
heart.about: Cardiac muscle forms four chambers that contract rhythmically, triggered by electrical impulses from the SA node — the pattern an ECG records. It creates systemic arterial pressure, and adult cardiac muscle regenerates poorly.

lung.label: Lung
lung.about: Alveolar tissue sits at the end of a branching bronchial tree. The lungs expand and relax with every breath; their function is read as airflow, breathing rate and SpO₂ rather than an electrical signal. Alveolar cells can repair themselves comparatively well.
